channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Treasury yields rise as global bond sell-off continues
item.description: Treasury yields continued to climb on Wednesday as inflation fears stoked a global rise in borrowing costs.

item.title: Iran says two tankers have hit Hormuz naval mines, attacks regional targets in retaliation to U.S. strikes
item.description: U.S. forces completed another wave of strikes against Iran on Tuesday stateside, hitting multiple Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps sites across the country.

item.title: Meta settlement could clear the way for new AI product launches, Morgan Stanley says
item.description: "There are certainly signals, in our view, that Meta's product pipeline could start flowing following this legal clearing event," analysts said.

item.title: U.S. crude tops $90 as Iran retaliates with strikes on Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain
item.description: Oil were volatile Wednesday, as Mideast tensions continue to escalate after the U.S. attacked Iran, while Tehran reportedly struck back at U.S. allies.

item.title: Goldman adds three new names to its favorite stocks list — including a standout 77% upside call
item.description: Goldman added an energy stock, a Dutch payment processing company and a German insurance name to its latest European stock picks list.

item.title: China's Xi keeps Iranian president at arm's length weeks ahead of Trump summit
item.description: China's Xi gave Iran's Pezeshkian a brief, low-profile audience at the SCO summit, as Beijing seeks to avoid appearing close to Tehran ahead of a high-stakes summit with Trump.

item.title: Dell surges 9% after lifting fiscal 2027 forecast on AI server strength
item.description: Dell sees AI server revenue tripling in fiscal 2027. Six months ago, it was looking for the number to double.

item.title: U.S. House votes to avoid government shutdown amid GOP hard-liner resistance
item.description: The U.S. House on Tuesday voted in favor of a short-term spending measure that would avoid a government shutdown until after November's midterm election.

item.title: China dissented from G20 statement opposing 'cheap exports' flooding market, Bessent says
item.description: Bessent is leading the Trump administration's plan to choke off Iran's economy by threatening its business partners with secondary sanctions.

item.title: Scaramucci says he had 'Potomac fever' in the White House — and Bessent and Lutnick have it too
item.description: "You think you're smarter than the people that live in Washington, but Washington changes you, you don't change Washington," Anthony Scaramucci told CNBC.

item.title: Nepal’s mountain tourism industry faces ‘serious warning’ after Himalayan flood disaster

item.description: Republicans also inserted a call to pass the highly controversial voter-ID bill known as the SAVE America Act into the socialism resolution.
